region.finding: All 24 source/battle front/side head/body slices actually inspected across 13 clips at six phases. Black nose compresses to a thin wedge during downward alternate idle; lower cheek droops toward scarf in walk, gallop and attack, with jagged mouth and narrowed snout in death. Gloves, belt, legs, feet and tail remain connected. Separate candidate targets measured non-head face influences with a smooth neck fade. Independent anatomy, full-body geometry, conservation and actual visual inspection required before promotion. Candidate v1 rejected: new death transition edge 10020/10016 affects forearm vertices below the face. V2 raises the lower fade boundary to preserve that forearm while retaining measured lower-face coverage. Candidate v2 rejected for eight transition warnings around both arms and chest. V3 widens the smooth vertical and depth transition; face coverage and original geometry remain unchanged and full-body checks remain required.

All 24 source/battle front/side head/body slices actually inspected across 13 clips at six phases. Tapir muzzle changes length and hooks downward during walking, gallop, attack and hit reaction; lower jaw stretches toward scarf while the eye and forehead stay steady. Death flattens snout into a sharp wedge. Body, limbs, ears and headband ties remain connected. Separate candidate targets measured non-head face influences with a smooth neck fade. Independent anatomy, full-body geometry, conservation and actual visual inspection required before promotion.

All 24 source/battle front/side whole-face and body slices actually inspected across 13 clips at six phases. Long white snout and pink nose flatten into a thin strip during walk, gallop, jump, attack, hit and entrance; recoil pulls the eye and cheek along the narrowing snout. Both qualities fail. Ears, forelegs, hind legs, harness and curled tail stay connected. Separate candidate targets measured non-head face influences with a smooth neck fade. Independent anatomy, full-body geometry, conservation and actual visual inspection required before promotion.

Separate candidate targets measured non-head face influences with a smooth neck fade. Independent anatomy, full-body geometry, conservation and actual visual inspection required before promotion.
